t: Introduction and overview — Ilyushin Il-2 Sturmovik
name: Introduction and overview — Ilyushin Il-2 Sturmovik — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Ilyushin Il-2 Sturmovik
description: Introduction and overview of the Ilyushin Il-2 Sturmovik: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Ilyushin Il-2 Sturmovik is a single-engine armored ground-attack aircraft, the most-produced military aircraft in history with 36,183 built. Its armored bathtub protected pilot and engine from ground fire on the Eastern Front. Soviet troops called it the 'flying tank'; it was essential to the Red Army's advance. Baseline facts: Armored ground-attack aircraft; 36,183 built by Ilyushin; most-produced military aircraft ever..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: Ilyushin Il-2 Sturmovik: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Armored ground-attack aircraft; 36,183 built by Ilyushin; most-produced military aircraft ever.
